sentences.text: The KFS instructions for UCBs apply to all new retail and MSME term loans sanctioned on or after 1 October 2024, including fresh loans to existing customers.
The older KFS circular was superseded, and it also used 1 October 2024 as the date for new retail and MSME term loans.
So the evidence does not support 1 January 2023 as the date when these KFS rules applied to new loans.
